Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From alpí +‎ -ista.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [əl.piˈnis.tə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [al.piˈnis.ta]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Noun

[edit]

alpinista m or f by sense (plural alpinistes)

  1. mountaineer, hiker

Related terms

[edit]
  • alpinisme

Further reading

[edit]
  • “alpinista”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007
  • “alpinista”, in Gran Diccionari de la Llengua Catalana, Grup Enciclopèdia Catalana, 2026
  • “alpinista” in Diccionari normatiu valencià, Acadèmia Valenciana de la Llengua.
  • “alpinista” in Diccionari català-valencià-balear, Antoni Maria Alcover and Francesc de Borja Moll, 1962.

Italian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /al.piˈnis.ta/
  • Rhymes: -ista
  • Hyphenation: al‧pi‧nì‧sta

Noun

[edit]

alpinista m or f by sense (masculine plural alpinisti, feminine plural alpiniste)

  1. mountaineer, climber, alpinist

Related terms

[edit]
  • alpinismo
  • alpinistico

Further reading

[edit]
  • alpinista in Treccani.it – Vocabolario Treccani on line, Istituto dell'Enciclopedia Italiana

Anagrams

[edit]
  • spalatini

Polish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin Alpīnus +‎ -ista.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /al.piˈɲis.ta/
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -ista
  • Syllabification: al‧pi‧nis‧ta

Noun

[edit]

alpinista m pers (female equivalent alpinistka)

  1. mountaineer, alpinist, mountain climber
    Synonyms: taternik, wspinacz

Declension

[edit]
Declension of alpinista
singular plural
nominative alpinista alpiniści/alpinisty (deprecative)
genitive alpinisty alpinistów
dative alpiniście alpinistom
accusative alpinistę alpinistów
instrumental alpinistą alpinistami
locative alpiniście alpinistach
vocative alpinisto alpiniści

Further reading

[edit]
  • alpinista in Wielki słownik języka polskiego, Instytut Języka Polskiego PAN
  • alpinista in Polish dictionaries at PWN

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From alpino +‎ -ista or from French alpiniste.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Rhymes: -istɐ
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /aw.piˈnis.tɐ/ [aʊ̯.piˈnis.tɐ]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /aw.piˈnis.tɐ/ [aʊ̯.piˈnis.tɐ]
    • (Rio de Janeiro) IPA(key): /aw.piˈniʃ.tɐ/ [aʊ̯.piˈniʃ.tɐ]
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /aw.piˈnis.ta/ [aʊ̯.piˈnis.ta]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /al.piˈniʃ.tɐ/ [aɫ.piˈniʃ.tɐ]

  • Hyphenation: al‧pi‧nis‧ta

Noun

[edit]

alpinista m or f by sense (plural alpinistas)

  1. climber, mountaineer, alpinist
    Synonym: montanhista

Related terms

[edit]
  • alpinismo

Further reading

[edit]
  • “alpinista”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “alpinista”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From alpino +‎ -ista.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /alpiˈnista/ [al.piˈnis.t̪a]
  • Rhymes: -ista
  • Syllabification: al‧pi‧nis‧ta

Noun

[edit]

alpinista m or f by sense (plural alpinistas)

  1. mountaineer
    Synonym: montañista

Derived terms

[edit]
  • alpinístico

Related terms

[edit]
  • alpinismo

Further reading

[edit]
  • “alpinista”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025

Tagalog

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish alpinista. By surface analysis, alpino +‎ -ista.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /ʔalpiˈnista/ [ʔɐl.pɪˈn̪is.t̪ɐ]
  • Rhymes: -ista
  • Syllabification: al‧pi‧nis‧ta

Noun

[edit]

alpinista (Baybayin spelling ᜀᜎ᜔ᜉᜒᜈᜒᜐ᜔ᜆ)

  1. alpinist; mountaineer; mountain climber
    Synonym: mamumundok

Related terms

[edit]
  • Alpes
  • alpinismo
  • alpino
  • Alpino

Further reading

[edit]
  • Cuadrado Muñiz, Adolfo (1972), Hispanismos en el tagalo: diccionario de vocablos de origen español vigentes en esta lengua filipina, Madrid: Oficina de Educación Iberoamericana, page 27
